:::{#def-tangent-plane}
#### Tangent plane

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have a [gradient](vector-calculus.qmd#def-vector-derivative) at $\vy$.
The **tangent plane**
[@wikipedia_tangent_space]
to the [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) of $f$ at $\vy$
is the graph of the function

$$
\vx \mapsto f(\vy) + \tp{\paren{\deriv{\vx} f(\vy)}} (\vx - \vy),
$$

which takes the value $f(\vy)$ at $\vx = \vy$ and has the same gradient as $f$ there.

:::
